overview.description: The MFS Active Core Plus Bond ETF (MFSB) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in broad credit fixed income. The fund is an actively managed fund that invests in debt securities of any credit quality and maturity issued by governments and corporations from around the globe. The fund seeks total return with an emphasis on current income. MFSB was launched on Dec 5, 2024 and is issued by MFS.
